publication_year.where: Page 393, journal header and publication information

country.where: Title, abstract, and Section 3.3; analysis covers 152 Korean local governments

sample_size.second_extractor_value: 152 local governments observed at three time points: 2010, 2016, and 2021 (n=152 in each yearly model)
sample_size.where: Section 3.3, page 396; Tables 5 and 8-15, pages 398 and 402-407

study_design.second_extractor_value: Multi-year observational quantitative study measuring distributional inequity with Coulter's coefficient and estimating associations with political, administrative, financial, and operational factors using yearly Tobit regressions, with multiple-regression results also reported

effect_estimate.second_extractor_value: For 2021, administrative district unit (si=1, gun=0) had significant negative coefficients for average unit price (-0.9174, p<0.01), cost recovery (-0.9064, p<0.05), revenue-water ratio (-0.8489, p<0.05), water-supply rate (-0.8566, p<0.01), and employees (-1.1569, p<0.01), but not customer satisfaction (-0.2666). Financial independence had significant positive coefficients for all six outcomes in 2021.

risk_of_bias_tool.second_extractor_value: JBI Analytical Cross Sectional Studies checklist is a reasonable appraisal tool because the study estimates observational associations separately at selected yearly cross-sections without an intervention or quasi-experimental design

mechanism_certainty.comment: The regressions document associations but do not directly observe a mechanism or use a quasi-experimental or experimental design.

outcome_flags.second_extractor_value: Supported: water_access, service_coverage, service_quality, affordability; formal_connection is at most implicit in the supplied-population measure. Service_reliability is not directly measured.
outcome_flags.comment: Revenue-water ratio measures accounted-for water or system efficiency, not continuity or reliability of household service, and formal household connections are not explicitly measured.

mechanism_flags.second_extractor_value: Supported concepts are administrative/service-area classification, fiscal autonomy, local tax burden, mayoral reappointment, private consignment, and local-public-enterprise status; fees appear principally as an outcome or recommended policy lever. Complaints are an outcome, while institutional fragmentation and political coordination are not directly measured.
mechanism_flags.where: Table 4, page 397; Tables 9-15, pages 402-407; conclusions, pages 404-405
mechanism_flags.comment: The recorded flags misclassify complaints as a mechanism, include unmeasured fragmentation and coordination, and omit directly tested fiscal and operational institutional factors.
